sn42.5:1.1: atha kho assāroho gāmaṇī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho assāroho gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.5:1.2: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
sn42.5:1.3: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.5:1.5: alaṃ gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.5:2.2: tatiyampi kho assāroho gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.5:2.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ assārohānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ,
sn42.5:2.4: yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti, pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.5:3.1: addhā kho tyāhaṃ gāmaṇi na labhāmi,
sn42.5:3.2: “alaṃ gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
sn42.5:3.4: yo so gāmaṇi, assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbeva hīnaṃ dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ
sn42.5:3.5: “ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā ahesuṃ iti vāti.
sn42.5:3.6: tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjito nāma nirayo tatthuppajjati.
sn42.5:3.8: “yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti, pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
sn42.5:3.9: micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.5:4.1: evaṃ vutte assāroho gāmaṇi parodi, assūni pavattesi.
sn42.5:4.3: “alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ, mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
sn42.5:4.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha.
sn42.5:4.5: api cāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi assārohehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paraddho
sn42.5:4.6: “yo so assāroho saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti. so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sarañjitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
